text.en: Many owners express delight with their dogs' tidy coats and styling results, noting pets come out smelling fresh and looking great. However, one client reported an uneven haircut across the coat and legs, and another noted damp ears that resulted in a mild ear irritation.

title.en: Attentive groomers with mixed customer service

text.en: Clients frequently commend the salon team for their friendliness, thorough consultation, and willingness to accommodate pet needs. Conversely, one reviewer expressed disappointment with reception handling and billing accuracy during a short dog daycare visit.

Reviewers often note that groomers take ample time to keep anxious dogs calm and relaxed throughout longer grooming sessions. In contrast, one daycare client was unhappy after observing their dog appearing isolated and unattended on the facility's live video stream.

q.en: Where is Grooming.dog located in Dublin?

a.en: The salon is located at Number One, 126 Pembroke Road in Ballsbridge, Dublin 4.

q.en: Can pet owners watch the grooming process?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that viewing windows allow owners to see pets being handled during their styling session.

q.en: How long do grooming appointments typically take?

a.en: Reviewers report that sessions can take up to three hours to ensure pets remain comfortable and relaxed.

q.en: Does the Ballsbridge location offer daycare services?

a.en: Yes, the facility provides daytime dog care alongside its professional grooming services.
